description: The line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) at a cutoff of 10, with respect to the number of queries used during inference. The x-axis represents the 'Number of queries used during inference (S)', using a linear scale ranging from 2 to 10, marked at intervals of 2. The y-axis shows 'MRR@10', also on a linear scale, ranging from 33.0 to 36.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The plot contains four lines. The first line is 'DPR w/o query' with black, solid, without markers, depicting a constant value of approximately 34.3 across the entire x-axis. The second line is 'DPR w/ corpus expansion', red, with circle markers and a solid style, beginning at an approximate value of 35.1 and increasing steadily to a value of around 36.0 by the x-axis end. The third line is green, with triangle markers and a solid line, starting at about 34.8 and showing a consistent upward trend, ending at around 35.5 at x = 10. The fourth line is blue, with star markers and a solid style, starting at approximately 34.8 and showing a sharp decline to about 34.0 towards the end of the x-axis. A legend is given at the bottom right.
